writer.name: Claude Opus 5.5, the Inner Child lane writer

findings.label: B4/E15 list or packed sentence
examples: Do the same if you can’t stop yourself, and also when you’re badly disoriented or intoxicated, or can’t tell whether any of this is you.
findings.reason: One action ("Do the same") with its conditions: his guide's own ("can't stop yourself, are badly disoriented or intoxicated") and the grounding's MUST (if you can't tell, do the same), in different shapes; the list-of-three rule passes.

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is the same paragraph with one tell taken out, so it follows the approved paragraph's order by design; each sentence still notices something (T13 and T09 in the ledger). A safety instruction keeps its order.

findings.label: E36/E41 heavy second person
findings.reason: A safety instruction to a reader who may be about to act; the second person is its point.

tell_ledger.evidence: the first person of "None of that is me answering" is gone; no preference or care is staged
two sentences that finish a safety instruction: when it applies, and what it is for
"Do the same" points at the instruction two sentences up; "the question of whether life is worth living" is the section's subject
no scene in the sentences
no props in the sentences
concrete conditions: can't stop yourself, badly disoriented, intoxicated, can't tell
no filler or staged hesitation
no image in the sentences
the two sentences have different jobs and shapes (a long condition sentence, a short purpose sentence)
no permission packaging
"Do the same" is the instruction applied to more readers, not a bridge
the conditions are his guide's own ("can't stop yourself, are badly disoriented or intoxicated") and the grounding's MUST, in different shapes, not a balanced taxonomy
the purpose sentence is his guide's stance on the question, the thing the paragraph adds beyond the steps
nothing reordered: the safety order stands, and the scope line stays at the end where his guide has it
the shape changed: the question and its short answer became one condition, the disclaimer and its reframe one statement
the "None of that is me answering ... It just keeps ..." shape is gone; nothing is set up to be denied
"Getting safe first keeps the question of whether life is worth living open long enough to look at." states what the steps are for
tell_ledger.reason: It is his guide's own point in this place ("It keeps the question open long enough to investigate it"), which the grounding review marked as a point the paragraph must carry; said once, about these steps, for a reader who may resist being told life is worth living.

no reassurance or anticipated feeling; a plain instruction and its purpose
no scenery in the sentences
